{{Top|leg}}
'''Interrupter-templates''' were metal panels on the underside of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that automatically slid into place along the [[servo-guide]]s upon the ship's landing. They prevented a ship equipped with a belly-[[Autoturret/Legends|turret]] weapon from shooting the landing gear or [[Entry ramp/Legends|ramp]] while the ship was in its landing configuration. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was equipped with interrupter-templates.
